name: Acidic Brew
description: Spills a pool of acid on a tile up to %cast_range% tiles away for %duration% turns. Enemies standing in it take %bonus_damage% extra damage from every source.
details: An enemy that ends its turn in the acid takes %damage% damage.
The pool sits where it was thrown for the full %duration% turns, whether anyone is standing in it or not.

upgrade.summary: Thrown %cast_range% tiles, and splashes over a %radius% tile radius.
upgrade.description: Spills acid over every tile within %radius% of a target up to %cast_range% tiles away, for %duration% turns. Enemies standing in it take %bonus_damage% extra damage from every source.
details: An enemy that ends its turn in the acid takes %damage% damage, however many of the splashed tiles it is standing on.
The pool sits where it was thrown for the full %duration% turns, whether anyone is standing in it or not.
